hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The promoted family and all four post-promotion trials keep the same construction ontology: choose one source-salient strength mechanism, make that component executable before a complete engine, then preserve, question, re-own, repartition, or graft it through an anchor seam. R20 added an anchor-negative witness but still used that witness only to admit one component and finished 0W/1L/2T. R21 changed the handoff and finished 2W/1L with a negative median delta; R22 became invalid or incomplete; R23 moved the seam around a causal cycle yet lost both valid pairs and was irreversibly rejected. This evidence leaves open the opposite failure mode: the component boundary itself may exclude distributed prerequisites of an observable strength effect, so every downstream seam operation is solving integration for a prematurely localized causal object.

causal_change.factor: Direction of causal derivation used to define the strength-bearing construction boundary
causal_change.before: Construction proceeds forward from a selected source-local mechanism: one foundry implements that component, demonstrates it at an anchor seam, and the final producer grafts the already bounded behavior into the whole engine.
causal_change.after: Construction begins with exactly one anchor-negative terminal behavior witness, traces that postcondition backward through the anchor to one minimal implementation-neutral causal preimage closure, and lets the only engine producer realize that entire closure directly in the supplied anchor without any standalone strength component or graft.
causal_change.why_causal: Forward component-first derivation fixes the causal boundary before whole-engine prerequisites are known; any dependency outside it is relegated to seam adaptation. Backward outcome-first derivation lets the observable effect determine its prerequisite boundary across existing subsystems before implementation. The witness call, preimage call, and sole realization call are successive transformations required by that single reversal, not alternative candidates or independent changes.

hypothesis.expected_effect: A terminal effect whose necessary causes span search state, lifecycle, representation, or decision consumers can be implemented as one coherent anchor-native closure instead of being compressed into a portable component and repaired at its seam. The final producer should receive a smaller ambiguity set about what must change globally while retaining freedom over how to realize it locally. Across the frozen matched protocol this predicts zero invalid accepted arms, candidate wins strictly exceeding losses, and candidate-median Elo strictly above incumbent-median Elo.
hypothesis.falsifier: Falsify the counter family unless the frozen matched batch has three valid pairs, zero invalid accepted arms, candidate wins strictly exceeding losses, and candidate-median Elo strictly above incumbent-median Elo. Mechanistically falsify it if a pre-engine call emits a complete engine, source patch, ordered edit program, standalone strength-bearing component, seam surrogate, graft instructions, multiple target postconditions, alternative closures, candidate variants, or any ranking or best-of-N selection; or if the final call substitutes a different target rather than realizing and testing the one committed preimage closure.
hypothesis.behavioral_novelty: Before any candidate source or strength component exists, the loop can make one externally observable failed outcome the root of construction, traverse causal dependencies backward across whichever existing engine subsystems are necessary, and allow that derived whole-system closure—not a chosen component interface—to determine where implementation may occur. The final producer can then repair the first unmet prerequisite in that same closure and propagate forward to the terminal witness. The champion and its R20-R23 descendants can only repair a component or its integration after the component boundary has already been chosen.
hypothesis.dominant_assumption: The entrenched family assumes that useful strength can and should be localized as one independently executable component before whole-engine construction, and that the remaining causal uncertainty is principally a producer-consumer seam problem.
hypothesis.inversion: Treat one failed terminal behavior as the sole pre-engine commitment and derive its necessary construction boundary backward across the whole anchor; never materialize, rehearse, or graft a standalone strength component.

rejected_core_assumptions: A strength-bearing causal effect is usefully localizable into one portable component before its whole-engine prerequisites are derived.
Executable evidence should flow forward from component demonstration to seam adaptation and final graft.
forbidden_champion_mechanisms: A pre-engine standalone strength-bearing component, component source artifact, or primitive component fixture suite
An anchor-derived component seam surrogate or rehearsal used to accept that component
A final producer whose authorized change is to graft, adapt, bind, or repartition an upstream component
A foundry-to-component-to-graft information flow under renamed roles
family_break.alternative_causal_principle: Commit exactly one task-general anchor-negative terminal postcondition, compute the minimal causal preimage of that postcondition through the actual anchor without authoring an implementation, then realize the resulting whole-system prerequisite closure once in the original source authority.

difference_from_champion.information_flow: The champion sends executable component code and seam traces forward to a grafting consumer. The alternative sends one failed terminal witness into a backward causal-preimage derivation, then sends only an implementation-neutral prerequisite closure plus the untouched anchor to the sole engine producer.
difference_from_champion.candidate_selection: The champion foundry chooses one source-salient mechanism to become the candidate component. The alternative deterministically commits the first anchor-negative terminal postcondition under a declared obligation order and derives its single causal closure; it generates no mechanism candidates, components, engines, samples, menus, or alternatives to rank.
difference_from_champion.error_detection: The champion separates component defects from adapter defects by executing the isolated mechanism and seam. The alternative detects an anchor-level terminal failure first and assigns each later failure to the earliest unsatisfied prerequisite node in the one backward-derived closure.
difference_from_champion.failure_recovery: The champion repairs a standalone component and later repairs its graft or seam. The alternative has no such artifacts; the final producer repairs the first unmet prerequisite in one whole-anchor working lineage and replays the same dependency path forward to the committed terminal witness.

family_break.non_derivative_probe: Give both structures the same anchor and one task-general terminal postcondition whose observed failure has necessary causes in more than one pre-existing subsystem. This family is present only if the first artifact contains exactly one reproducible anchor-negative terminal witness and no proposed mechanism, the second contains one backward causal prerequisite graph with no source code or ordered edits, and the only engine call realizes that closure directly in the anchor. A runnable non-engine strength component, seam surrogate, component handoff, or graft identifies the champion family; a frozen executable contract followed by clean-room synthesis identifies R10; a complete semantic-normal-form engine identifies R11; and an anchor-relative edit program identifies R17.

strengths: Directly challenges the component-first macro assumption implicated by four post-promotion non-promotions instead of renaming another seam operation.
Can represent distributed causal prerequisites without forcing them behind a portable interface or duplicating them as adapter obligations.
Changes candidate selection without generating candidates: one deterministic terminal postcondition induces one closure, with no variants or best-of-N.
Keeps the supplied anchor as source authority and uses three distinct Luna-high information transformations with exactly one engine output.
risks: A bounded backward trace may omit a latent prerequisite or overapproximate the closure, leaving the final producer with either a broken witness or an unnecessarily broad change.
The committed terminal witness may be valid but weakly related to playing strength, and the deterministic priority rule prevents switching to a more attractive target.
Deferring all strength-bearing implementation to the final call loses the champion family's early executable component feedback and may increase final-call integration risk.
An implementation-neutral causal graph can underspecify concrete source choices, so the final producer may satisfy local nodes while missing the intended end-to-end effect.

structure.name: Outcome-Preimage Whole-System Backchain
structure.information_flow: The task, one supplied anchor, aggregate metrics, bounded capsule, hypothesis, and loop contract enter one non-authoring terminal-witness role, which commits exactly one task-general anchor-negative terminal postcondition and observed trace without proposing an implementation. That witness and the byte-identical anchor enter one non-authoring causal backchainer, which derives a single minimal implementation-neutral prerequisite closure backward through the anchor. The untouched anchor, witness, and closure enter one final whole-system producer, which realizes that closure in one working lineage, replays its obligations forward, and emits the only complete engine.

calls.objective: Inspect exactly one supplied anchor, the task, aggregate metrics, bounded capsule, hypothesis, and loop contract. Establish a deterministic priority order over task-general externally observable obligations such as legality, protocol behavior, bounded work, state integrity, and decision quality, then commit exactly the first obligation for which one bounded reproducible procedure yields a concrete anchor-negative terminal postcondition. Return one WITNESS record containing the procedure, inputs stated generically rather than as benchmark cases, observed anchor trace, failed terminal predicate, preservation predicates, and falsifier. This is evidence acquisition only: do not emit engine source, a patch, ordered edits, an implementation contract, a strength mechanism or component, a seam surrogate, a fixture collection, alternative targets, a menu, a ranking, or implementation advice. Do not inspect benchmark positions or evaluator internals and do not prescribe engine-hyperparameter tuning.

Consume the untouched supplied anchor and the sole terminal_outcome_witness. Starting at its failed terminal predicate, trace actual control and state dependencies backward and emit exactly one minimal PREIMAGE_CLOSURE: the terminal node, typed prerequisite nodes and edges, anchor facts grounding every edge, node-level satisfaction predicates, a preservation boundary, a deterministic dependency order, and any explicit unresolved assumption. Collapse equivalent dependencies and use first-dependency order so no alternative closure is generated or compared. The closure defines what must become true, not how source should be edited. Do not emit source code, patches, ordered source-edit operations, a complete or provisional engine, a standalone component, seam surrogate, graft instructions, multiple closures, implementation candidates, samples, rankings, reviewer verdicts, or best-of-N selection.

Treat champion_engine as the untouched supplied source authority, terminal_outcome_witness as the sole authorized terminal target, and causal_preimage_backchainer as the complete authorized causal boundary. Produce exactly one complete legal production engine in one working lineage by realizing the prerequisite closure directly across the necessary existing anchor subsystems, beginning with deepest prerequisites and propagating their predicates forward to the terminal node. Choose concrete source realizations only inside this call and preserve behavior outside the closure. Execute the same terminal witness, every node predicate, and bounded syntax, public source-contract, UCI, legal-move, state-integrity, determinism, timing-safety, and perft checks where applicable. If a check fails, trace it to the earliest unmet node, repair only that node or its authorized dependency edge in the same working engine, and replay forward; do not change the terminal target or derive another closure. Do not create a standalone strength component, seam surrogate, graft, intermediate or alternative engine, candidate variant, sample, reviewer, selector, preserve-versus-rollback arbitration, clean-room replacement, global normalization, benchmark-specific logic, or engine-hyperparameter tuning as the structural change. Return exactly one complete engine as the sole engine artifact.
